name: spelling-and-grammar
title: Spelling and Grammar
description: Fix spelling and grammar in the selected text using your own Anthropic, OpenAI, or OpenAI-compatible (e.g. OpenRouter) API key.
author: flash286

commands.name: fix-spelling-and-grammar
commands.title: Fix Spelling and Grammar
commands.subtitle: AI
commands.description: Correct the spelling and grammar of the selected text, review the changes, then paste.

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Provider
preferences.description: Which API to call for corrections.

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Required when the provider is Anthropic. Create one at console.anthropic.com.

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Required when the provider is OpenAI. Create one at platform.openai.com.

preferences.name: openaiCompatibleApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI-compatible API Key
preferences.description: Required when the provider is OpenAI-compatible. For OpenRouter, create one at openrouter.ai/keys.

preferences.name: openaiCompatibleBaseUrl
preferences.title: OpenAI-compatible Base URL
preferences.description: Used when the provider is OpenAI-compatible. /chat/completions is appended. Defaults to OpenRouter.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Optional override. Defaults to claude-sonnet-5 for Anthropic, gpt-4o for OpenAI, and openai/gpt-4o for OpenAI-compatible.

preferences.name: customInstructions
preferences.title: Extra Instructions
preferences.description: Optional. Appended to the correction prompt, e.g. "use British spelling".

preferences.name: showDiffFirst
preferences.title: View
preferences.label: Also show removed text
preferences.description: When on, the result includes struck-through removals. Toggle per-run with Cmd+D.

scripts.test: node scripts/test-diff.mjs && node scripts/test-stream.mjs && node scripts/test-request.mjs
